alternatives.description: Leave active Garden automation prompts and repository schedule only partially bound to the new engine.
alternatives.projected_effect: Lane-local process interpretations can drift from GardenProcess despite the engine existing.
alternatives.risk: Duplicate route/state semantics and audit ambiguity remain possible.

alternatives.description: Record every active Garden automation as a worker around GardenProcess and make schedule/profile consistency executable.
alternatives.projected_effect: The engine becomes the single route/state authority and lane prompts become role-specific workers.
alternatives.risk: Operational coupling to the engine increases, so engine failures must fail closed and remain independently auditable.

bidirectional_gaps.gap: DO_NOTHING lacks complete machine-readable lane-to-engine coverage and permits prompt-level state drift.
Binding adds a maintained manifest and test obligation absent from the looser configuration.

assumptions: GardenCanonicalUpdateProcess@1.4 remains the HUMAN-admitted governing process.
GardenProcessEngine@1 is already merged and is the authoritative route/state implementation.
Discovery-only and unrelated research tasks should not fabricate GardenProcess state.
Automation prompts constrain worker roles but cannot mint authority.
reason.uncertainty: Live automation service state is external to repository tests, so the manifest records the intended active bindings while Pipeline Health must detect runtime drift.
counterexamples: A blind reviewer advancing BLIND_REVIEW_COMPLETE by itself would violate the worker/engine boundary.
Research Scout creating a ProcessRouteReceipt would improperly turn discovery into authoritative routing.
An automation treating algebra validation as promotion authority would be invalid.
A scheduled Garden lane missing from the binding manifest would create an unaudited process surface.
reason.conclusion: Bind all active Garden automation lanes to the merged process engine, keep discovery/non-Garden research outside state mutation, and enforce schedule/binding consistency with tests.

obligations.statement: Every scheduled Garden lane has exactly one automation-engine binding.
Discovery-only and unrelated research tasks do not fabricate GardenProcess state.
Lane prompts cannot override protected authority or Process Algebra boundaries.

items.claim_scope: Explicit instruction to update all automated Garden tasks and the repository after process-engine introduction.
Merged composable GardenProcess engine and Process Algebra-bound route/state implementation.
Current base includes independently published PipelineHealthReceipt, RuleEnforcementCoverageReceipt and DerivedLaneRegistry evidence.
